credits.text: Era 1 journey events written for this guide from the Coppermind's chapter summaries

events.title: A scam at the Canton of Finance

summary.text: Vin, a street thief in Camon's crew, helps him con an obligator at the Ministry's Canton of Finance, secretly using the 'Luck' she has always relied on.
Kelsier and Dockson take over Camon's hideout. Kelsier tests Vin and tells her she is Mistborn, and she meets his crew and hears their plan to overthrow the Lord Ruler.

art.alt: Two small cloaked figures, one in a tasselled mistcloak, stand in falling ash and mist below Luthadel's towering dark walls and spires, faint blue lines running from them.

summary.text: To train as a noblewoman, Vin goes to Lord Renoux's mansion in Fellise, a short way outside Luthadel.

art.alt: A young woman in a red gown approaches a young nobleman reading at a lamp-lit table in a grand hall.

summary.text: Vin attends her first ball as Lady Valette Renoux, where she meets Elend Venture for the first time.
Kelsier takes Vin into the Lord Ruler's palace. Fighting their way out, she kills for the first time and narrowly escapes an Inquisitor.
Vin and Kelsier race out to the caves where the crew's skaa army trained, after most of it marched out to fight too early.
In Fountain Square, Vin watches the Lord Ruler's Inquisitors behead skaa in public.

art.alt: Vin, in a white shirt and mistcloak, grapples at close quarters with a dark-haired noblewoman Allomancer among tall spires.

summary.text: At the last ball at Keep Venture, Vin learns that assassins are after Elend, fights them off and kills Shan Elariel, though she is badly hurt.

art.alt: The Lord Ruler, long-haired in a dark embroidered coat, strides forward unharmed with two spears run through his chest, Luthadel's spires behind him under a red sky.

summary.text: In Fountain Square, Vin watches the Lord Ruler kill Kelsier in front of a crowd of skaa.

art.alt: Vin, in a tasselled mistcloak and holding a dagger, flies through the night towards the spires of a dark palace above a lit gate.

summary.text: Vin breaks into Kredik Shaw alone and gets past two Inquisitors to reach the Lord Ruler's secret building.

art.alt: Wreathed in swirling mist, Vin faces the Lord Ruler, who grips a kneeling Steel Inquisitor by the head with one hand and reaches towards her with the other.

summary.text: Freed from her cell by Sazed, Vin fights the Lord Ruler, draws power from the mists, tears off his bracers and kills him.

art.alt: Vin in a mistcloak flings coins through the mists, cutting down an attacker who falls backwards.

summary.text: A year after the Lord Ruler's fall, a group of Allomancers attacks Vin in the mists. She beats them with help from an unknown Mistborn watching her.
A messenger from Straff Venture's army turns out to be the Mistborn who has been watching Vin.

art.alt: Vin in a white gown, bloodied and holding a dagger, looks back over her shoulder.

summary.text: When Allomancers attack Elend at an Assembly meeting, Vin kills them in front of the crowd but is badly hurt.
Vin goes with Elend into his father Straff's army camp outside Luthadel to negotiate.
Pushed by Zane, Vin storms Keep Hasting, where Lord Cett is staying, and comes close to killing him.
When Vin refuses to leave with him, Zane attacks her. OreSeur turns out to be Zane's kandra, TenSoon, and Vin kills Zane.
Wounded, Vin proposes to Elend, and Sazed marries them.
Vin and Elend leave the besieged city, heading north to look for the Well of Ascension.
Learning that the koloss outside Luthadel have no one controlling them, Vin runs back alone on a pewter drag.

art.alt: Vin swings a huge sword as she fights her way through a crowd of koloss in a city under a red sky.

summary.text: Back in the city, Vin fights through the koloss to Keep Hasting and takes control of them.
Leading the koloss, Vin attacks Straff's army, kills Straff, and makes the other lords accept Elend as emperor.

art.alt: Vin stands in a swirl of white, eyes blank and glowing, as power rises up around her.

summary.text: Beneath Kredik Shaw, Vin finds the Well of Ascension and takes in its power. She gives it up instead of using it, and frees something imprisoned there.

art.alt: Vin stands on top of a fallen koloss, a huge spear beside her, under a grey sky

summary.text: Vin and Elend save Vetitan from a koloss army by taking control of it, then find a storage cavern hidden by the Lord Ruler beneath the town.

art.alt: An army winds through a rugged, ashy landscape toward a city in the hills under a swirling sky

summary.text: Elend's army camps outside Fadrex City, held by King Yomen, and Vin sets out to scout it.
Vin slips into Fadrex City and visits an informant, Slowswift, to learn about Yomen.

art.alt: Elend in a light suit holds Vin's hand as she stands in a long blue ball gown

summary.text: Vin and Elend walk openly into a ball at Keep Orielle, in the heart of Yomen's city.
During a ball at the Canton of Resource, Vin goes searching underground for the city's storage cavern and is locked in.
Vin wakes in chains with no metals, a prisoner of King Yomen.
Vin breaks out of Yomen's prison and fights off Marsh, and Yomen lets Elend's army into Fadrex.
From inside Fadrex, Vin watches a huge koloss army gather outside the city with Elend and Yomen.

art.alt: Vin clings to a tall spiked spire high above a city as robed figures leap through the air around her

summary.text: Vin reaches Luthadel with Mistborn on her trail, and Inquisitors waiting.

art.alt: Vin, sword in hand, fights a swarm of leaping, spiked Inquisitors among tall stone spires

summary.text: With her earring torn out, Vin draws the mists into herself, kills the Inquisitors and brings down Kredik Shaw.
Holding the mists' power, Vin rises above Luthadel and confronts Ruin while she tries to repair the land.
Vin follows Ruin to the Pits of Hathsin, where refugees are sheltering.

art.alt: Elend swings a huge sword while Vin, eyes glowing, raises a hand beside him amid falling ash and mist

summary.text: As Elend and his soldiers face the koloss, Vin sacrifices herself to kill Ruin.
Lord Cett's daughter Allrianne leaves her father's army, comes to Elend's palace asking for asylum and throws her arms around Breeze.
Sent away by Breeze, Allrianne rides out of Luthadel with Elend, Vin and Spook, then goes her own way once they are past Straff's army.
Escorted by bandits she has talked into helping her, Allrianne reaches her father's army on its way home and argues that he should turn back to Luthadel.
When Vin leads koloss against Straff's army outside Luthadel, Allrianne charges toward the battle alone, and Cett sends his army in after her.
Allrianne reaches Urteau with Sazed and Breeze as Elend's envoys, and Spook takes them to their base above the hidden cache.
At an execution in Urteau, Allrianne Riots the crowd into rushing the guards, so that Spook and the girl he saved from the burning building can get away.
Allrianne notices the mists acting strangely and warns Breeze, and the people of Urteau gather in the caverns.
Allrianne is in Urteau's cavern when the world is remade, and comes out into a green land where the city used to be.
Yomen, head of the Ministry in Fadrex City, fights Lord Cett for control of it, and secures the city once Cett marches away to Luthadel.
At a ball at Keep Orielle, Elend sits down at King Yomen's table and demands his surrender. Yomen refuses, claiming the Lord Ruler's authority.
Yomen raids Elend's camp outside Fadrex as a distraction while his siege engines kill half of Elend's koloss.
At a ball in the Canton of Resource, Yomen debates Elend, fights back when Elend attacks him, and then captures Vin beneath the building.
Questioning Vin, Yomen maps the Lord Ruler's caches with her. Then the Inquisitor Marsh arrives, refuses to help him and calls him an unprofitable servant.
At Marsh's order Yomen sends his soldiers against Elend's army, but Vin talks him round: he calls a retreat and gives Elend's army safe passage into Fadrex.
Touring Fadrex with Elend, Yomen visits the infirmary, where Elend finds that the mists have made Allomancers of the mistfallen. Yomen gathers metals so they can fight.
As the mists vanish and the heat rises, Yomen tells Elend he is a Seer and gives him his bead of atium.
After the Lord Ruler's death, Cett seizes the Western Dominance but can't hold Fadrex City, where the obligator Yomen gains ground on him.
Ham tells Elend and Vin that the Allomancers who ambushed Vin in Luthadel's mists were sent by Ashweather Cett, King of the Western Dominance.
Cett's army arrives outside Luthadel, the second to besiege the city. His advisor Breeze escapes from the camp to Elend.
Cett reveals himself at the Assembly, is nominated for king and makes his case, then moves into an empty keep in the city with a thousand soldiers.
Vin and Zane storm Keep Hasting, where Cett is staying, cut through his guards and throw him to the floor, but Vin lets him live.
Having pulled out of Luthadel, Cett is marching home when his daughter Allrianne rides into camp and argues that he should go back.
Pushed by Allrianne, Cett sends his army against Straff's outside Luthadel, and afterwards Vin makes him accept Elend as emperor.

art.alt: An army winds through a rugged, ashy landscape toward a city in the hills under a swirling sky

summary.text: Now one of Elend's generals, Cett helps plan the siege of Fadrex City and gives Vin a list of informants inside it.
In the battle against the koloss at Fadrex, Cett stays behind the lines directing tactics while Elend fights.
Invited by Dockson, Breeze comes to Kelsier's meeting in Camon's old hideout, Soothes Vin until she notices, and agrees to join the plan to overthrow the Lord Ruler.
Breeze teaches Vin about zinc and brass, then he and his Soothers and Rioters make a skaa crowd in Luthadel more willing to listen to Kelsier's speech.
With the skaa army lost, Breeze and the crew watch from a rooftop as skaa are executed in Fountain Square, and Kelsier talks them into carrying on.
When Kelsier attacks the prisoner carts in Fountain Square, Breeze stays on the rooftop and, with Vin's help, works on the emotions of the soldiers below.
In the Western Dominance, Breeze becomes one of Lord Cett's advisors and steers him into marching his army on Luthadel.
Breeze rides out of Cett's camp for Luthadel with archers on his heels, and Vin holds them off so he can reach the city.
Lord Cett's daughter Allrianne turns up at Elend's palace asking for asylum, and greets Breeze with a hug, to the crew's surprise.
At the Assembly, Lord Cett points out the Soothers that Breeze has placed in the audience to help Elend.
Having told Allrianne to leave the city, Breeze watches from the wall with Sazed, Ham and Clubs as Elend's small party slips out through the Tin Gate and past Straff's army.
As the koloss attack Luthadel, Breeze burns through his brass Soothing the frightened defenders at the Zinc Gate, until the koloss break it down.
Clubs is cut down by a koloss while saving Breeze, who hides in a nearby building until Ham and Sazed find him and lead the survivors to Keep Hasting.
Breeze reaches Urteau with Sazed and Allrianne as Elend's envoys. The Citizen, Quellion, lets them stay, and Spook takes them to their base and the hidden cache.
Breeze watches with Sazed and Allrianne as prisoners are locked in a burning building, and sees Spook break out with a young girl.
When Quellion's speech turns to riots and fires, Breeze Soothes the crowd's fear while Allrianne Riots them toward calm.
While Spook recovers from his burns, Breeze runs Urteau day to day, making proclamations and settling disputes.
Allrianne warns Breeze that the mists are acting strangely, and Spook has him gather everyone in Urteau into the caverns.
Breeze climbs out of the cavern with Spook and Beldre to find green grass under a blue sky, and no trace of Urteau.
Clubs walks out of Kelsier's pitch at Camon's hideout, then comes back and agrees to join the crew as its Smoker.
Clubs' carpentry shop becomes the crew's base, where Vin wakes the morning after Kelsier's pitch. Spook lives and works there too.
Kelsier's last letter picks Clubs to lead the skaa against the palace. He fetches the crowds calling Kelsier's name to Kelsier's weapons warehouse.
A year after the Lord Ruler's fall, Clubs is general of King Elend's army. At Keep Venture he bets on Vin in her sparring match with Ham.
From the city wall, Clubs watches Elend, Vin and Spook slip out of the besieged city.
As the koloss attack Luthadel, Clubs commands the defence at Zinc Gate alongside Breeze.
When the koloss break through Zinc Gate, Clubs orders the defenders to fall back into the city and is cut down by a koloss as Breeze watches.

art.alt: A vast lit cavern where ranks of skaa soldiers gather around a roped-off ring for a duel, watched from a ledge by a man in a mistcloak.

summary.text: At the caves where the skaa army trains, Captain Demoux duels the dissenter Bilg. With Kelsier secretly helping, he wins, but refuses to kill Bilg.
When Yeden marches most of the army out to attack, Demoux stays behind at the caves with about two thousand soldiers, where Kelsier and Vin find them.
Vin follows Demoux out of Keep Venture into Luthadel's streets and finds him preaching to skaa for the Church of the Survivor.
Now a general, Demoux commands part of Elend's army, camped by a canal where Elend and Vin bring the refugees from Vetitan.
When Elend has his soldiers go out into the mists on the march, Demoux is one of those who fall sick.
Outside Fadrex, after a brawl between the mistfallen and other soldiers, Elend sends Demoux and his company of mistfallen back towards Luthadel.
Elend finds Demoux and the mistfallen at the Pits of Hathsin, where the Terris and several hundred thousand refugees have gathered.
At the Pits, Demoux finds he can burn atium, as can all the mistfallen. He and his men charge the koloss army alongside Elend.
Dockson meets his old friend Kelsier back in Luthadel and goes with him to watch Camon's crew try to con the Ministry at the Canton of Finance.
At Camon's old hideout, Dockson joins the crew Kelsier gathers and hears his plan to overthrow the Final Empire.
Collecting weapons at Lord Renoux's mansion in Fellise, Dockson tells Vin how he fled a plantation after its lord took and killed the woman he loved.
When Kelsier leaps in to free prisoners at an execution in Fountain Square, Dockson stops Vin from following him into the fight.
Dockson leads the crew to Kelsier's warehouse, where they find a hidden store of weapons, and starts handing them out to the skaa.
Hunting a kandra spy in the palace, Vin tests Dockson's memories. He tells her his view of the nobility has softened, and she judges him genuine.
When koloss break into Keep Venture during the attack on Luthadel, Dockson is killed as he tries to fall back.

art.alt: A young woman in a red gown approaches a young nobleman reading at a lamp-lit table in a grand hall.

summary.text: At a ball at his family's keep, Elend finds a young noblewoman, Valette Renoux, sitting in his reading spot and talks with her.

At the last ball at Keep Venture, Elend ends his friendship with Valette. That night intruders come for him, and his father Straff later tells him they were assassins, one of them a Mistborn, Shan Elariel.
Thinking Valette is among the prisoners in Fountain Square, Elend pushes into the fighting to find her. An Inquisitor nearly kills him, but Kelsier attacks it and saves him.
As skaa riots break out, Straff leaves the city but Elend stays. He sends his household to Keep Lekal and goes with five soldiers to give himself up to the rebel leaders.
Learning that Valette, really Vin, has been captured by the Lord Ruler, Elend leads his soldiers into Kredik Shaw and fights the guards around her cell, buying her time to find her metals.
After the Lord Ruler's death, Elend speaks out against skaa rebels killing surrendering palace soldiers, describing a fairer nation. The speech leads to him being crowned king.
A year into Elend's reign, his father Straff Venture arrives at Luthadel with about fifty thousand soldiers and lays siege to the city.
Elend persuades the Luthadel Assembly to wait until he has parleyed with Straff before deciding the city's fate. Then news arrives of a second army outside the walls.

art.alt: A small carriage crosses the ashy ground toward a tall gate in Luthadel's walls.

summary.text: Elend and Vin go into Straff's camp to negotiate, and bluff their way out when Straff threatens to kill him. Back in the city, Elend learns the Assembly has voted him out as king.

At the vote for king, Elend declares his faith in the Survivor, then Vin fights off assassins who attack him. When the Assembly meets again at Penrod's mansion, Elend honestly admits votes can change, and Penrod wins.
Elend slips out of Luthadel alone to meet his old friend Jastes Lekal, who leads the koloss army. When Jastes refuses to take it away, Elend stabs him and escapes using him as a hostage.
Vin comes to Elend wounded, saying she has killed his half-brother Zane. She proposes, he accepts, and Sazed marries them.
Elend and Vin slip out of the besieged city with Spook, heading north toward Terris to look for the Well of Ascension.
Finding that Jastes has abandoned his koloss outside Luthadel and followed them, Elend executes him. When Spook reveals Sazed tricked them into leaving, they turn back for the city.
Elend and Spook reach Luthadel with a group of Terris refugees. Vin tells him the other lords have accepted him as Emperor.
Beneath Kredik Shaw the mist spirit stabs Elend, and Vin gives up the Well's power rather than use it to save him. She then feeds him a bead of metal, and he burns pewter and recovers.
Elend rides alone into Vetitan and leads its men against an approaching koloss army, and with Vin takes control of the koloss. Beneath the town they find one of the Lord Ruler's storage caverns.

art.alt: An army winds through a rugged, ashy landscape toward a city in the hills under a swirling sky

summary.text: Elend's army reaches Fadrex City, held by King Aradan Yomen, and camps outside to besiege it rather than attack.

art.alt: Elend in a light suit holds Vin's hand as she stands in a long blue ball gown

summary.text: At a ball inside Fadrex, Elend meets his old friend Telden, argues with Yomen over his right to rule the city, then dances with Vin.
Elend keeps Yomen talking at a ball while Vin searches for the storage cavern, then tests him in a scuffle and withdraws. Back at camp, a note from Yomen says Vin has been captured.
Elend decides not to attack Fadrex, but his koloss are taken from his control and turn on his army. Vin persuades Yomen to let the survivors into the city.
In a Fadrex infirmary, Elend realizes the mist sickness is Snapping people into Allomancers, and has his mistfallen soldiers drink metals to fight the koloss.
When the mists vanish, Yomen gives Elend his bead of atium, and Elend leaves Fadrex for Luthadel to find Vin.

art.alt: A broken road runs between shattered, jagged spires under a red sky

summary.text: Elend finds Kredik Shaw in ruins and King Penrod dead at Keep Venture. A whisper on the wind sends him on toward the Pits of Hathsin.

art.alt: Elend swings a huge sword while Vin, eyes glowing, raises a hand beside him amid falling ash and mist

summary.text: At the Pits of Hathsin, Elend finds his mistfallen soldiers can burn atium and leads them against the koloss for hours. Marsh kills him, and Vin gives her life to destroy Ruin.
Lord Penrod, one of the most influential nobles left in Luthadel, sits in the Assembly as Elend asks it to wait until he has parleyed with Straff.
With Elend deposed, the Assembly makes Penrod its chancellor at Elend's suggestion. Penrod, Elend and Lord Cett are nominated for king.
After assassins attack the Assembly's election meeting, the members regroup at Penrod's mansion. When Cett's two voters switch to him, Penrod becomes king.
As koloss overrun Luthadel, Penrod shuts himself in Keep Hasting and refuses to take in refugees, until Vin arrives with koloss of her own and orders his soldiers out to protect the people.
After Vin defeats Straff's army outside Luthadel, she makes Penrod, Cett and Straff's general Janarle accept Elend as Emperor.
At Keep Venture, Marsh attacks King Penrod and drives a metal spike into his chest. Penrod survives, and his surgeons leave the spike in place.
Luthadel is overcrowded and choked with ash, and the guards at Keep Venture say King Penrod has gone mad.
Elend finds Penrod dead at Keep Venture in an emptied Luthadel. He had killed himself, leaving a note that something had taken control of him.
Goradel grew up in Luthadel, where his family worked the fields outside the city. He left to join the Lord Ruler's army, and they disowned him.
On guard outside Kredik Shaw when Vin breaks in, Goradel is talked into joining the rebellion instead of fighting her, and is the first to walk away.
Goradel tells Dockson that Vin has been captured, then leads Elend and his guards into the dungeons of Kredik Shaw, where they find Vin and Sazed already free.
Now a captain, Goradel leads the soldiers guarding Sazed, Breeze and Allrianne, resupplying at Luthadel on the way to Urteau.
During Quellion's speech in Urteau, Goradel's soldiers rush the stage to fight the Citizen's guards.
Goradel rides out of Urteau carrying an urgent message from the wounded Spook to Vin.
On the road, the Inquisitor Marsh attacks Goradel. He fights back hard but is killed, and Marsh reads Spook's message.
Ham, a Thug who hires out as muscle for thieving crews, comes to Kelsier's meeting in Camon's old hideout and joins the plan to overthrow the Lord Ruler.

art.alt: A man in a mistcloak looks down from a ledge over a vast lit cavern where ranks of skaa soldiers train around a roped-off sparring ring.

summary.text: In hidden caves outside Luthadel, Ham trains the skaa rebel army as General Hammond, and Kelsier comes out to inspect it.
Kelsier sends Ham to Luthadel's Garrison and Vin goes along to learn pewter, but they find the soldiers marching out because the skaa army has attacked Holstep.
Ham leads a band of rebels into Fountain Square and frees Spook and the other prisoners, then pulls Vin away after the Lord Ruler kills Kelsier.
As the skaa rise up across Luthadel, Ham's fighters bring down Keep Elariel and attack the other noble keeps.
A year after the Lord Ruler's fall, Ham stands with Elend on Luthadel's walls, looking out at Straff Venture's army as the siege begins.
As the koloss overrun Luthadel, Ham and Sazed find Breeze and lead what is left of their soldiers to Keep Hasting, where Ham gives Vin his pewter.
Searching beneath Kredik Shaw with Vin, Elend and Spook, Ham comes on Marsh about to kill Sazed and knocks him out with a dueling cane.

art.alt: An army winds through a rugged, ashy landscape toward a city in the hills under a swirling sky

summary.text: Ham leads Elend's army to Fadrex City and helps plan the siege, though he worries about marching his soldiers through the mists.
Ham tells Elend that sending the koloss against Fadrex would be wrong. When the koloss turn on their army, Ham's soldiers retreat into the city.
Ham fights the koloss besieging Fadrex alongside Elend, until the mists change and the koloss suddenly leave for Luthadel.
Ham, who sheltered in Fadrex's caverns, comes out into a green world under a blue sky, meets Spook and Breeze, and learns his family is safe in another cavern.
Years ago, a failed job against the Lord Ruler sent Kelsier to the Pits of Hathsin, the Lord Ruler's prison mines. He is the only prisoner known to have escaped.
In the Pits, Kelsier lost his wife Mare. There he Snapped, found he was Mistborn, and broke out.

art.alt: Ash falls on a plantation: a lord and obligators watch from a terrace while skaa labour in the fields below.

summary.text: Visiting Lord Tresting's plantation, Kelsier steps in when a skaa girl is taken to the manor, kills Tresting and his men, and burns the manor down.

Kelsier meets his old friend Dockson in Luthadel and watches a young thief, Vin, Soothe an obligator at the Canton of Finance. He and Dockson then plan to draw off the obligator and Inquisitor tailing her crew.
Kelsier rescues Vin from Camon, takes over his hideout and gathers a crew there. He pitches a plan to overthrow the Final Empire and reveals that Vin is Mistborn.
To start trouble between the noble houses, Kelsier breaks into Keep Venture, steals its atium and fights his way out past the house's guards.

art.alt: Two small cloaked figures, one in a tasselled mistcloak, stand in falling ash and mist below Luthadel's towering dark walls and spires, faint blue lines running from them.

summary.text: Kelsier takes Vin over the city wall and out to Lord Renoux's mansion in Fellise, offering her the chance to leave the crew. She stays.
Kelsier leads Vin into the Lord Ruler's palace to find a building the Lord Ruler visits every few days. Inquisitors are waiting, and the two barely escape.
Kelsier leaves a murdered nobleman in Keep Tekiel's garden, then poses as a crippled skaa informant to feed Lord Straff Venture rumours.

art.alt: A man in a mistcloak looks down from a ledge over a vast lit cavern where ranks of skaa soldiers train around a roped-off sparring ring.

summary.text: Kelsier travels by canal to the caves where Ham is training the rebels' skaa army, and wins over the recruits.
After the army marches out too early, Kelsier runs to the caves with Vin. He leaves the beaten army to its fate and leads away the two thousand men still there.
From a rooftop over Fountain Square, Kelsier and the crew watch Inquisitors behead skaa, and he talks them into carrying on with the job.
Kelsier sends the crew into hiding and goes alone to the Pits of Hathsin, where he smashes the crystals that grow the atium geodes.

art.alt: The Lord Ruler, long-haired in a dark embroidered coat, strides forward unharmed with two spears run through his chest, Luthadel's spires behind him under a red sky.

summary.text: Trying to free skaa prisoners in Fountain Square, Kelsier fights and kills a Steel Inquisitor. Then the Lord Ruler arrives and kills him in front of the crowd.
In Kelsier's warehouse, the crew find his letter and OreSeur wearing his body. Kelsier meant his death to rouse the skaa, and OreSeur has been showing himself to them as Kelsier risen.
At Clubs' shop, Marsh argues with his brother Kelsier over old times. Kelsier talks him into coming back to hear the plan.
Marsh visits Lord Renoux's mansion in Fellise and teaches Vin how to use bronze to sense other Allomancers.
Now inside the Steel Ministry, Marsh meets Kelsier and Vin in the Twists and tells them about the Ministry's Soothing stations.

events.title: A body at the meeting place

summary.text: Kelsier and Vin find a butchered body at the place Marsh chose for their next meeting. Vin takes a hollowed-out table leg he used to hide messages.

art.alt: Wreathed in swirling mist, Vin faces the Lord Ruler, who grips a kneeling Steel Inquisitor by the head with one hand and reaches towards her with the other.

summary.text: Marsh, now a Steel Inquisitor, kills the other Inquisitors as they sleep, then kills Kar and attacks the Lord Ruler to help Vin.

art.alt: Sazed holds up a torch in the dark, with Marsh in his Inquisitor's robes half-hidden in shadow behind him.

summary.text: Acting strangely, Marsh leads Sazed to the Ministry's empty Conventical of Seran. While Sazed copies an old inscription, Marsh searches the Inquisitors' quarters.
As Sazed hurries to Kredik Shaw to warn Vin, Marsh attacks him and nearly kills him, until Ham knocks him out.
Under Ruin's control, Marsh walks through a starving town near Mount Tyrian, kills a Smoker to make a new spike, and watches the volcano erupt.
Marsh slips into Luthadel and attacks King Penrod in Keep Venture, leaving a spike in his chest as Ruin intends.
Marsh comes to Fadrex demanding the atium's location, turns Yomen against Elend's army and fights Vin, who drives him off.
Marsh kills Goradel, reads a letter from Spook meant for Vin, and sets off for Luthadel.
At Kredik Shaw, Marsh tortures Vin for the atium's location. Fighting Ruin's hold for a moment, he rips out her earring.
Filled with the mists, Vin kills every other Inquisitor. She pulls a spike from Marsh but vanishes before she can finish him.
Burning atium, Marsh joins the battle at the Pits of Hathsin and kills Elend with his axe.
Hired by Kelsier, the kandra OreSeur poses as Lord Renoux, a western nobleman, at a mansion in Fellise where Vin comes to train.
Still posing as Lord Renoux, OreSeur is taken by the Ministry to Fountain Square in a prison cart, where an Inquisitor buries an axe in his back.
At Kelsier's warehouse, OreSeur shows the crew he now wears Kelsier's body. On Kelsier's orders he has been appearing to the skaa as Kelsier risen.
Now bound to Vin, OreSeur is badly hurt when Allomancers ambush her in the mists. She won't let him take one of the dead attackers' bodies.
Not wanting him to wear human bodies, Vin buys a wolfhound and brings it to OreSeur to take on instead, over his protests.
Serving Zane under Contract, TenSoon killed OreSeur and took his place as Vin's wolfhound.
When Zane attacks Vin, her wolfhound kandra obeys him instead: it is Zane's kandra TenSoon, who had taken OreSeur's place.

events.placeName: On the way to the Well
events.title: Guiding Alendi

summary.text: On his uncle Kwaan's orders, the young Terris packman Rashek guides Alendi on his journey to the Well of Ascension, meant to lead him astray or kill him. The Well lies beneath what is now Luthadel.

art.alt: An old man in furs kneels by a glowing pool in a cave while a shadowed figure behind him raises a knife.

summary.text: At the Well of Ascension, in the cavern that now lies under Kredik Shaw, Rashek kills Alendi and takes the Well's power for himself, becoming the Lord Ruler.
With the power, Rashek moves the world closer to the sun to burn away the mists, and when it grows too hot he makes the ashmounts erupt, filling the sky with ash and smoke.
To hide the Well, Rashek raises new mountains in the far north and names that land Terris, then flattens his real homeland.
Rashek builds his capital, Luthadel, on his flattened homeland, with Kredik Shaw around a copy of his old Terris hut, set right over the Well.
Beneath Kredik Shaw, the Lord Ruler stocks a secret cavern with food and supplies, and leaves a map of the empire etched in metal.
In a storage cavern under Fadrex City, the Lord Ruler leaves a metal plate saying Ruin spoke in his mind, that he tried to rule well, and that he hid Ruin's body.
Years before, Inquisitors caught Kelsier and his wife Mare trying to rob the Lord Ruler in Kredik Shaw. He thanked Mare for betraying Kelsier and sent them both to the Pits of Hathsin.

art.alt: The Lord Ruler, long-haired in a dark embroidered coat, strides forward unharmed with two spears run through his chest, Luthadel's spires behind him under a red sky.

summary.text: At public executions in Fountain Square, the Lord Ruler ignores two spears through his chest, kills Kelsier with one blow, and orders the killing of skaa to go on.
In his throne room in Kredik Shaw, the Lord Ruler dismisses the skaa uprising and, after Vin is brought before him, hands the Lord Prelan Tevidian to the Inquisitors to be killed.

art.alt: Wreathed in swirling mist, Vin faces the Lord Ruler, who grips a kneeling Steel Inquisitor by the head with one hand and reaches towards her with the other.

summary.text: In his throne room in Kredik Shaw, the Lord Ruler turns out to be Rashek, the Terris packman from the logbook, who took the Well's power himself. Vin tears off his bracers and kills him.
Sazed, a Terris steward working for Kelsier, meets Vin with a carriage and takes her to Lord Renoux's mansion in Fellise to learn to pass as a noblewoman.
Sazed arrives at Clubs' shop with the badly hurt Vin after her night in Kredik Shaw, stitches her wounds, and offers to translate the old book she brought out.
At the Renoux mansion in Fellise, Sazed tells Vin how Feruchemy works and why the Keepers began storing memories.
Following Vin into the palace, Sazed is beaten and locked in the cell next to hers. He uses a hidden metalmind to break them both out, then takes Elend to safety.
Sazed comes back with metals and a wooden spear for Vin, and is there when she kills the Lord Ruler with it.
Travelling as a Keeper, Sazed teaches skaa villages in the Eastern Dominance and looks into a man's strange death that a witness blames on the mists.

art.alt: Sazed holds up a torch in the dark, with Marsh in his Inquisitor's robes half-hidden in shadow behind him.

summary.text: Marsh, now an Inquisitor, leads Sazed to the empty Conventical of Seran. Underneath it Sazed finds a steel plate written by a Terrisman named Kwaan and takes a charcoal rubbing of it.
Heading north, Sazed finds the villagers of Urbene dead in their homes. He carries out the one man still alive, then hurries on toward Luthadel.
About a week from Luthadel, Sazed runs into a koloss army led by Jastes Lekal. He refuses to serve Jastes and leaves carrying a message for Elend.
Sazed reaches Luthadel under siege, warns the crew about Jastes's twenty thousand koloss and the danger of the mists, and is scolded by Tindwyl for ignoring the Synod.
Sazed marries Vin and Elend and urges them north to find the Well of Ascension. Privately, he has sent them away so they will survive when the city falls.

art.alt: Sazed stands alone before a city gate as koloss leap toward him through the falling ash.

summary.text: When the koloss attack, skaa watching Sazed call him the Holy First Witness. Using his metalminds, he fights the koloss for hours and holds the Steel Gate until Vin arrives.
After hours of searching the burning city, Sazed finds Tindwyl's body. He mourns her but cannot choose any religion's rite to perform.
Following the mist spirit into Kredik Shaw, Sazed is attacked by Marsh and badly hurt until Ham saves him. He reaches Vin too late to stop her at the Well.
Back at the Conventical of Seran, Sazed finds that his rubbing no longer matches the steel plate: the words had been changed. The last of his faith leaves him.
As Elend's ambassador, Sazed waits with Breeze for King Audil Lekal to sign a treaty submitting to Elend's rule, and gets it.
On his way to Urteau, Sazed visits the Terris people now living at the Pits of Hathsin. They welcome him warmly, but he refuses to stay and lead them.
Sazed reaches Urteau as Elend's ambassador, but the Citizen, Quellion, turns down any alliance. As their carriage leaves, Spook meets them, dressed as a soldier.
In Urteau, after rejecting the last religions on his list, Sazed hears TenSoon call him the Announcer and learns that the first kandra were Rashek's Terris packmen. He decides to go to the kandra.
Riding TenSoon in the shape of a horse, Sazed reaches the kandra Homeland in caves at the Pits of Hathsin and goes in alone.
The First Generation of kandra tell Sazed about Preservation and Ruin, and show him the hoard of atium they have hidden from Ruin.
Locked up when KanPaar seizes power, Sazed is freed by TenSoon. He guards the kandra's atium until Elend arrives at the Homeland, and tells him the hoard is there.

art.alt: Sazed, in Terris robes, stands with arms spread as two great swirls of power, one bright and one dark, pour into his hands

summary.text: At the Pits, after Vin and Elend die, Sazed realizes he is the Hero of Ages. He takes up the powers of Preservation and Ruin and uses all his stored knowledge to remake the world.
Lestibournes, Clubs' teenage nephew, sits in on the crew's planning at Clubs' shop, speaking a thick Eastern street slang.
From a rooftop, Spook and Vin watch House Elariel attack House Hasting, and he teaches her tricks for burning tin.
Captured with Lord Renoux while leaving Luthadel, Spook is brought to Fountain Square in a prisoner cart. Ham and the rebels break open his cage while Kelsier fights.
Spook leaves the besieged city through the Tin Gate with Elend and Vin, heading north toward the Terris mountains.
On the road, Spook spots the men following them and admits that Sazed sent Elend and Vin away so they would survive the attack on Luthadel.
Heading back to Luthadel with Elend, Spook meets Terris refugees fleeing Tathingdwen, and the two travel on with them.
Spook and Elend reach Luthadel with the refugees and find the city has held, with Elend now emperor.
Spook follows Vin, Elend and Ham into the caverns under Kredik Shaw in search of the Well of Ascension.
In Urteau, flaring tin constantly, Spook spies on the meetings of the Citizen, Quellion, and watches Quellion's sister, Beldre.

art.alt: Spook, his eyes covered by a cloth and wrapped in a dark cloak, leans close to talk to a red-haired young woman in a plain dress

summary.text: After an execution, Spook slips up to Beldre and tells her that her brother will die. Quellion's guards spot him and go after him.

art.alt: Spook, eyes covered and barefoot, leaps out between soldiers in front of a burning building

summary.text: Spook wakes in a burning building, badly hurt. A figure who looks like Kelsier guides him to some vials, and he finds he can now burn pewter and escapes.
Dressed as a soldier, Spook meets Sazed, Breeze and Allrianne in Urteau and leads them to an empty Canton of Inquisition building, with the Lord Ruler's supply cache hidden beneath it.
Spook slips into a building where the Citizen is burning prisoners, kills the soldiers, and leaps out of the burning building with a young girl.
When Beldre comes to plead for her brother's life, Spook keeps her as a hostage and spreads word that she has left Quellion.

Confronting Quellion, Spook realizes the metal in their bodies is the source of their powers and of the voice. He pulls it out of both of them, then runs through the flames to start the machine that floods the canals.
Still recovering from his burns, Spook hears a voice telling him to warn Vin. He writes a message in steel and Goradel carries it out of the city.

art.alt: Vin and Elend lie still together in a field of white flowers

summary.text: Spook climbs out of the cavern into a green world where Urteau used to be. He finds Vin and Elend's bodies and Sazed's book, which says Sazed has made him Mistborn.
In his office at Keep Venture, Straff tells Elend he means to ally with Lord Tegas, so House Venture can crush House Hasting faster if war comes.
At the last ball at Keep Venture, Straff thins the guards around Elend's rooms before Elariel assassins strike. Afterwards he tells Elend one of them was a Mistborn, Shan Elariel.
As skaa riots break out, Straff leaves Luthadel. He lets Elend stay behind, hoping he will be killed.
A year after leaving, Straff returns with an army of about fifty thousand and besieges Luthadel, where his son Elend is now king.
In his camp, Straff hears Zane's report on Vin. A serving girl tries to poison his tea; he has her killed and later takes an antidote from one of his mistresses.
Elend and Vin come to Straff's camp to negotiate. Straff threatens Elend but, unnerved by Vin, lets them leave, then orders Zane to kill her.
Straff makes a deal with Luthadel's new king, Penrod, to hand over the city. Then Zane tells him he has been poisoned; Amaranta's remedy saves him, and Straff decides Zane must die.
With Zane gone, Straff falls ill and realizes his mistress Amaranta has been drugging him and sleeping with Zane. He strangles her and brews his own antidote before collapsing.
Straff holds his army back while koloss ravage Luthadel. The next morning Vin leads koloss and soldiers against his army and kills him.
After a ball at Keep Hasting, Telden meets Elend, Jastes and other young nobles in a tower to drink and talk about the Lord Ruler's faults. Vin listens in from outside.
At a ball at Keep Lekal, Telden and Jastes warn Elend not to trust Valette Renoux, suspecting she spies for another house.
At the last ball at Keep Venture, Elariel assassins target Elend and his friends, Telden among them. Vin fights them off before they reach the room.
As the house war breaks out, House Elariel attacks Keep Hasting, Telden's family home, in the night.
Telden, now living in Fadrex City, meets Elend at a ball at Keep Orielle. He tells Elend he is acting like the Lord Ruler, then asks about his marriage to Vin.
Yomen sends Telden down to Vin, trapped in the cavern beneath the Canton of Resource. He talks her into drinking drugged wine so she can be moved.

art.alt: Vin and a wolfhound leap across the sky above Luthadel's rooftops and towers

summary.text: Serving Zane under Contract, TenSoon killed OreSeur, Vin's kandra, and took his place as her wolfhound companion in Luthadel.

The wolfhound Vin knew as OreSeur turns out to be TenSoon, Zane's kandra. When Zane attacks Vin, she takes control of TenSoon with Allomancy; with Zane dead, TenSoon asks her forgiveness and leaves for the kandra Homeland.
Without bones, TenSoon waits in a cell in the kandra Homeland and insists on his right to be judged in public.

art.alt: A vast cavern hall seen from above, crowds gathered around a lit circle at its centre

summary.text: Tried in the Trustwarren for breaking his Contract with Zane, TenSoon argues that he served a greater Contract by helping Vin, and that the kandra should serve her.
Sentenced to a long imprisonment and then death, TenSoon breaks free in his wolfhound body and outruns the kandra guards.
Looking for Vin in crowded, ash-covered Luthadel, TenSoon takes on Kelsier's bones and questions guards at Keep Venture, then heads for Urteau.
In Urteau TenSoon finds Sazed instead of Vin. He tells Sazed that the first kandra were Rashek's Terris packmen and offers to take him to the Homeland.
In the shape of a horse, TenSoon carries Sazed to the kandra Homeland at the Pits of Hathsin, then leaves to find Vin.
Cut off from Fadrex by a river of lava, TenSoon heads back east. In the Homeland he frees Sazed and the First Generation, then poses as their guard FhorKood.
Seized by Ruin, TenSoon attacks Sazed. When the First Generation call the Resolution, he removes his spikes with the other kandra.
Tindwyl, a Terris Keeper, lets herself be caught listening in on Elend's meeting at Keep Venture, then offers to teach him how to be a king. He accepts.
When Sazed returns to Luthadel, Tindwyl meets him in his rooms and scolds him for ignoring the Synod's orders to teach in the Eastern Dominance.

art.alt: Sazed and Tindwyl lean together over an open old book.

summary.text: Studying old texts with Sazed, Tindwyl says she will leave the city, but when he asks her to stay, she does.
As Elend prepares to leave Luthadel, Tindwyl tells him he is abandoning his people. She stays behind in the city with Sazed.
Tindwyl commands Tin Gate when the koloss attack. The gate falls hours into the battle, and Tindwyl is killed; Sazed later finds her body.
Before he shows himself, Zane secretly watches Vin in the mists, and quietly helps her when a group of Allomancers ambushes her.
The Mistborn who has been watching Vin comes to Keep Venture as a messenger from Straff Venture's army, gives his name as Zane, and invites Elend to a meeting in Straff's camp.
That night Zane and Vin test each other in a steel-pushing contest at Keep Hasting. He tells her that Mistborn belong in the mists, not among nobles.
Zane ignores a voice in his head telling him to kill, collects a message from his spy in Elend's palace, and reports to Straff in his camp on winning Vin's trust.
During Elend's parley in Straff's camp, Zane finds Vin waiting outside the tent. Afterwards Straff orders him to kill her.
On the roof of Elend's keep, Zane attacks Vin burning atium, then stops. He says Straff wants her dead, that he would rather take her away, and that he is Elend's half-brother.
Blaming Cett for plots against Elend, Zane leads Vin into Keep Hasting, where they cut through Cett's soldiers. When Vin spares Cett, Zane leaves.
Zane kills a man sent to murder him in his sleep and confronts his father, Straff. Then he takes metals and atium and leaves the camp to find Vin.
Zane begs Vin to leave Luthadel with him. When she refuses, he attacks her; her kandra, OreSeur, turns out to be his, TenSoon, and Vin kills Zane.
